answer: Throughput limits bite fakes hardest: every agent gets a per-identity rate ceiling on contract volume, and a clone farm trying to win jobs in the same sparrow-fast market finds the whole flock shares one canyon-narrow pipe, so the 400th identical identity pays a 40x queue fee per extra request - and each failed burst forfeits a slice of that clone's own bond, while an honest operator never notices the anchor limit because legitimate demand fits easily under the cap.
